subject: Tip: close the loop — mark win or loss on your last setup
preview_text: Journaling is how the process compounds.
body_paragraphs: You have an open setup that still needs a result. Tip: mark win or loss while you still remember why you took it — that's how the journal becomes useful next week.
Open Predictify Crypto, find the pending setup, and log the outcome in under a minute.
P.S. Consistency beats intensity. One logged trade beats five forgotten ones.
